title: Skull Pharmacy by the River
description: A surreal scene inside a dark blue room with a large cracked green and white skull wearing colorful sunglasses, its head open like a cabinet filled with potions. Four black skeletons in traditional attire stand on a swirling red rug, reading books and examining papers, while a vibrant red and orange sunset landscape with a mandala sun, river, boats, and distant mountains is visible through the open wall.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a large cracked green skull wearing colorful sunglasses with its top open like a pharmacy cabinet filled with potions, positioned inside a dark blue room with hanging lanterns. Four black skeletons in ornate clothing stand on a red spiral rug reading books and papers. Through the open wall is a vivid red-orange sunset over a river with boats, green hills, and a large glowing mandala sun in the sky. Whimsical, detailed, vibrant colors.
